name: PANGE LINGUA
confidence: imported, unchecked: held back as a draft
licence: Public domain. The Open Hymnal Project marks this hymn “copyright: public domain” (words, music and setting), and places its own editing, indexes and data files in the public domain.
reviewNotes: Held back: the score has no time signature (a chant or free rhythm), which the solfa grid cannot bar; bar 6 does not add up to 4 beats; bar 9 does not add up to 4 beats. Imported from the Open Hymnal Project's ABC score; check the notes and the words against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The score gives no year for the tune; it was in print by 1898, the year of the setting the Open Hymnal copied. The last 6 verses are printed after the score in the source, not under the notes. The tune ends on E, not on the key note: it may be modal. The Open Hymnal's own source: "The Church Hymnal, Revised and Enlarged" (Episcopal), 1898 Hymn 98, alt. Alterations by Brian Dumont, 03 Nov 2025. All alterations released into the public domain. Lyrics Source: "Mediæval Hymns" by John Mason Neale, 1851 pg 1-4
